+.name: Plus
+.meaning: Addition; between terms of a sum.

*.name: Product
*.meaning: Ordinary multiplication. Printed by writing the factors side by side.

/.name: Fraction
/.meaning: Division, printed as a fraction bar.

^.name: Power / superscript
^.meaning: Raises to a power, or carries an upper index (tensor components, conjugation labels).

_.name: Subscript
_.meaning: Attaches a lower index: a component, a species, a particle label.

!.name: Factorial
!.meaning: n! = 1·2·3···n: the number of orderings of n things.

·.name: Dot product
·.meaning: a·b = |a||b|cos θ: how much two vectors point the same way; a scalar.

×.name: Cross product
×.meaning: a×b is perpendicular to both, with length |a||b|sin θ. Order matters: a×b = −b×a.

sqrt.name: Square root
sqrt.meaning: √x: the number whose square is x.

abs.name: Absolute value / modulus
abs.meaning: |x|: size without sign; for a complex number, its distance from 0.

norm.name: Norm
norm.meaning: ‖v‖: the length of a vector or state.

sum.name: Summation
sum.meaning: Σ_{k=a}^{b} f: add f for every k from a to b.

sumk.name: Summation over an index
sumk.meaning: Σ_k f: add f over every value of the index k.

prod.name: Product over an index
prod.meaning: Π_{k=a}^{b} f: multiply f for every k from a to b.

binom.name: Binomial coefficient
binom.meaning: (n k) = n!/(k!(n−k)!): ways to choose k things from n.

lim.name: Limit
lim.meaning: lim_{x→a} f: the value f approaches as x approaches a.

d.name: Derivative
d.meaning: df/dx: the rate at which f changes as x changes.

d2.name: Second derivative
d2.meaning: d²f/dx²: how the rate of change itself changes - curvature, acceleration.

pd.name: Partial derivative
pd.meaning: ∂f/∂x: the rate of change of f with x while every other variable is held fixed.

pd2.name: Second partial derivative
pd2.meaning: ∂²f/∂x²: curvature of f along x alone.

pdm.name: Mixed partial derivative
pdm.meaning: ∂²f/∂x∂y: how the slope along x changes as you move along y.

int.name: Integral
int.meaning: ∫ f dx: the accumulated total of f over x - the area under its curve; with limits, from a to b.

oint.name: Closed-loop integral
oint.meaning: ∮ f dl: an integral all the way round a closed curve (circulation).

iint.name: Surface integral
iint.meaning: ∬_S f dA: integral over a surface (flux through it).

iiint.name: Volume integral
iiint.meaning: ∭_V f dV: integral over a volume.

grad.name: Gradient ∇
grad.meaning: ∇f: the vector pointing up the steepest slope of a field, with the slope as its length.

div.name: Divergence ∇·
div.meaning: ∇·F: how much a vector field spreads out of a point (a source) or into it (a sink).

curl.name: Curl ∇×
curl.meaning: ∇×F: how much a vector field circulates around a point, and about which axis.

lap.name: Laplacian ∇²
lap.meaning: ∇²f = ∇·∇f: how much f at a point differs from its average around it. Diffusion, waves, potentials.

vec.name: Vector arrow
vec.meaning: x⃗: marks a quantity with a direction as well as a size.

hat.name: Unit vector / operator hat
hat.meaning: x̂: a direction of length 1 - or, in quantum mechanics, an operator.

bar.name: Bar
bar.meaning: x̄: an average, a complex conjugate, an antiparticle, or the Dirac adjoint ψ̄ = ψ†γ⁰.

conj.name: Complex conjugate
conj.meaning: z*: flip the sign of the imaginary part; z·z* = |z|².

dag.name: Hermitian adjoint †
dag.meaning: A†: conjugate transpose. An observable equals its own adjoint.

bra.name: Bra ⟨ψ|
bra.meaning: ⟨ψ|: the dual of a state; it eats a ket and returns a number.

ket.name: Ket |ψ⟩
ket.meaning: |ψ⟩: a quantum state - a vector in Hilbert space.

braket.name: Inner product ⟨φ|ψ⟩
braket.meaning: ⟨φ|ψ⟩: the overlap of two states; |⟨φ|ψ⟩|² is the probability of finding ψ in φ.

mel.name: Matrix element ⟨φ|A|ψ⟩
mel.meaning: The amplitude for A to take ψ to φ.

avg.name: Expectation value ⟨A⟩
avg.meaning: ⟨A⟩ = ⟨ψ|A|ψ⟩: the average result of measuring A.

comm.name: Commutator [A,B]
comm.meaning: [A,B] = AB − BA: zero if the order of A and B does not matter.

acomm.name: Anticommutator {A,B}
acomm.meaning: {A,B} = AB + BA. Fermion fields and gamma matrices obey anticommutators.

hc.name: Hermitian conjugate (+ h.c.)
hc.meaning: "+ h.c.": add the Hermitian conjugate of everything before it, so the whole is real.

sin.name: Sine
sin.meaning: Ratio of opposite side to hypotenuse; oscillation.

cos.name: Cosine
cos.meaning: Ratio of adjacent side to hypotenuse; oscillation a quarter-turn ahead of sine.

exp.name: Exponential
exp.meaning: eˣ: growth whose rate equals its size.

ln.name: Natural logarithm
ln.meaning: The power e must be raised to.

log.name: Logarithm
log.meaning: The power the base must be raised to (base 10 or 2 where stated).

cosh.name: Hyperbolic cosine
cosh.meaning: (eˣ + e⁻ˣ)/2: the hanging chain, the rapidity boost.

arcsin.name: Inverse sine
arcsin.meaning: The angle whose sine is x.

arccos.name: Inverse cosine
arccos.meaning: The angle whose cosine is x.

arctan.name: Inverse tangent
arctan.meaning: The angle whose tangent is x.

Re.name: Real part
Re.meaning: Re z: the real component of a complex number.

Im.name: Imaginary part
Im.meaning: Im z: the coefficient of i.

arg.name: Argument (phase)
arg.meaning: arg z: the angle of a complex number from the positive real axis.

det.name: Determinant
det.meaning: det A: how a matrix scales volume; zero if it squashes space flat.

tr.name: Trace
tr.meaning: tr A: the sum of the diagonal; basis-independent.

erf.name: Error function
erf.meaning: erf x = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t²) dt: the area under a Gaussian.

Γ.name: Gamma function
Γ.meaning: Γ(n) = (n−1)!, extended to all complex numbers: ∫₀^∞ t^(z−1) e^(−t) dt.

e.name: Euler's number / charge
e.meaning: 2.71828..., the base of natural growth - or the elementary charge 1.602×10⁻¹⁹ C, as the puzzle says.

i.name: Imaginary unit
i.meaning: i² = −1. Rotates a complex number by a right angle.

∞.name: Infinity
∞.meaning: Larger than any number; a limit, not a value.

ħ.name: Reduced Planck constant
ħ.meaning: h/2π = 1.055×10⁻³⁴ J·s: the quantum of action.

h.name: Planck constant
h.meaning: 6.626×10⁻³⁴ J·s: energy per unit frequency of a light quantum.

kB.name: Boltzmann constant
kB.meaning: 1.381×10⁻²³ J/K: energy per kelvin per degree of freedom.

R.name: Gas constant / radius
R.meaning: 8.314 J/(mol·K) - or a radius, as the puzzle says.

ε0.name: Vacuum permittivity
ε0.meaning: 8.854×10⁻¹² F/m: how much the vacuum lets an electric field through.

μ0.name: Vacuum permeability
μ0.meaning: 1.257×10⁻⁶ N/A²: the magnetic counterpart of ε₀; c² = 1/(ε₀μ₀).

σ.name: Stefan-Boltzmann constant / cross-section / tension
σ.meaning: 5.67×10⁻⁸ W/(m²K⁴) - or a cross-section, a surface tension or a standard deviation, as the puzzle says.

α.name: Fine-structure constant / angle
α.meaning: ≈ 1/137: the strength of electromagnetism - or an angle or rate, as the puzzle says.

Λ.name: Cosmological constant
Λ.meaning: The energy of empty space, driving accelerated expansion.

z.name: z
z.meaning: A third coordinate, or a complex number.

a.name: a
a.meaning: An acceleration, a distance, a constant.

n.name: n
n.meaning: A count, a number density, or an integer.

k.name: k
k.meaning: An index, a rate constant, a wavenumber or spring constant.

E.name: E
E.meaning: An energy, or an electric field.

F.name: F
F.meaning: A force, or a field-strength tensor.

V.name: V
V.meaning: A volume, a potential or a voltage.

q.name: q
q.meaning: A charge or a generalised coordinate.

λ.name: λ
λ.meaning: A wavelength, a decay constant, a coupling or an eigenvalue.

φ.name: φ
φ.meaning: An angle, a phase, or a scalar field.

ψ.name: ψ
ψ.meaning: A wavefunction or a fermion field.

μ.name: μ
μ.meaning: A reduced mass, chemical potential, or a spacetime index.

γ.name: γ
γ.meaning: The Lorentz factor, a gamma matrix, or a ratio.

A.name: A
A.meaning: An area, amplitude or vector potential.

L.name: L
L.meaning: A length, angular momentum or Lagrangian.

H.name: H
H.meaning: A Hamiltonian, Hubble rate or enthalpy.

Z.name: Z
Z.meaning: A partition function, or an atomic number.

g.name: g
g.meaning: A coupling, gravity, a metric or degeneracy.

s.name: s
s.meaning: An entropy density, spin or selection coefficient.

K.name: K
K.meaning: A constant, or a kinetic energy.

D.name: D
D.meaning: A diffusion constant or a dimension.

W.name: W
W.meaning: Work, or a number of microstates.
